WAFF AMPUTEE FOOTBALL WORLD CUP 2026 MEXICO English Español WAFF AMPUTEE FOOTBALL WORLD CUP 2026 MEXICO Close From its early international competitions in the 1980s, amputee football has grown into a truly global sport, bringing together players, teams and communities from around the world. What began with pioneering tournaments in the United States has developed over more than four decades into an established international movement built on competition, inclusion, resilience and a shared passion for football. The Amputee Football World Cup has played a central role in this journey. Over the years, teams from Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas have come together to compete at the highest level and to showcase the quality, intensity and spirit of amputee football. Recent World Cups have taken place in Culiacán, Mexico in 2014, San Juan de los Lagos, Mexico in 2018, and Istanbul, Türkiye in 2022. At the most recent World Cup, Türkiye was crowned World Champion in 2022, winning the title on home soil. latest_news.excerpt: The Home of Blind Football in India - Home 2025 IBSA Men’s Blind Football Nations Cup Kochi, Kerala • 22nd September – 2nd October 2025 Participating Nations England India Iran Italy Korea Poland 🏆 About the Tournament The IBSA Men’s Blind Football Nations Cup is a prestigious global competition under the International Blind Sports Federation (IBSA). Featuring the world’s top-ranked teams between 9th and 16th, the Nations Cup showcases the intensity, skill, and passion of blind football on the international stage. For the first time in history, India will host this flagship men’s event — a landmark opportunity to promote inclusion, accessibility, and sporting excellence. Why India? India has quickly become a hub for blind football in Asia, with an impressive track record of hosting world-class events: 2022 IBSA Asia-Oceania Blind Football Championship 2023 IBSA Intercontinental Cup With top-class facilities, dedicated volunteers, and a passionate blind football community, India is ready once again to welcome the world and set the stage for unforgettable sporting action. 📺 Media & Live Broadcast Fans around the globe won’t miss a moment!
